name: Cook Islands
region: Polynesia (self-governing, in free association with New Zealand)
summary: Residents pay income tax on worldwide income at up to 30% (above NZD 80,000 on Rarotonga). There is no capital gains tax: only gains from dealing or from property bought for resale are income. Dividends, foreign ones included, are ordinary income at up to 30%, with credit for foreign tax. No wealth, estate or gift tax was found.

regimes.name: Tax residence (home in the Cook Islands)
regimes.description: Residents are taxed on worldwide income at 0% up to NZD 14,600, then 17%, 27% and 30% above NZD 80,000 (Rarotonga). The Pa Enua (outer islands) scale is 0% to NZD 60,000, then 27% and 30%.
regimes.eligibility: A person whose home is in the Cook Islands (Income Tax Act 1997 s.82(1)). Residence permits are controlled by the Cook Islands Government.

capital_gains.summary: No capital gains tax. Gains on property are income only if the taxpayer deals in such property, acquired it for resale, or made them in a profit-making scheme (Income Tax Act 1997 s.46(1)(c)).

Treatment of land sales (MFEM 'Taxation of Land Transactions' guidance) not read; that PDF is a scan.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Income Tax Act 1997 s.46(1)(c) taxes only gains from dealing, from property bought for resale, or from profit-making schemes. A long-term investor's gains on listed securities, business shares and real estate are therefore scored at 0.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Frequent trading or buying for resale makes gains ordinary income at up to 30% (s.46(1)(c)).

dividends.summary: All dividends are assessable income (s.46(1)(g)) at the individual's marginal rate, up to 30%. Foreign income tax on foreign income is credited (s.85).

open_questions: Whether any amendment introduced imputation credits or a final withholding for resident shareholders was not checked.
dividends.rate_basis: Top rate 30% (MFEM tax rates; above NZD 80,000). Dividends are gross income under s.46(1)(g). No imputation system was found in the 1997 Act; companies may elect to deduct dividends (s.59(k)).
dividends.withholding_outbound: 15% withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties paid to non-residents (s.100).
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive treaties; agreements with New Zealand and Australia cover only allocation of taxing rights for certain individuals' income and transfer-pricing MAP. TIEAs and CRS in place.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax. The tax legislation MFEM administers covers income tax, VAT, departure tax and customs only.

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: No general property tax was found; most land is customary land held under leases.

inheritance.summary: No estate, inheritance or gift duty was found: the tax legislation MFEM administers covers income tax, VAT, departure tax and customs only.

residency.tax_residency_test: An individual is resident if their home is in the Cook Islands (Income Tax Act 1997 s.82(1)). The standard deduction may be apportioned by residence or days present.

routes.name: Residence permit (Cook Islands immigration)
routes.requirements: The Cook Islands controls immigration itself, including for New Zealand citizens who are not Cook Islanders. Long-term residence needs a permit (details not researched).
